name: survreg.control
title: Package options for survreg and coxph

origin.description: Control parameters for survreg. A supplied iter.max replaces maxiter.
origin.usage: survreg.control(maxiter=30, rel.tolerance=1e-9, toler.chol=1e-10, iter.max, debug=0, outer.max=10)
origin.details: Control parameters for survreg. A supplied iter.max replaces maxiter.
origin.example:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(survival))
value <- (function() {
  a <- survreg.control()
  b <- survreg.control(iter.max = 12)
  c(sprintf("%.17g", a$maxiter), sprintf("%.17g", a$rel.tolerance),
    sprintf("%.17g", a$toler.chol), sprintf("%.17g", a$iter.max),
    sprintf("%.17g", a$debug), sprintf("%.17g", a$outer.max),
    sprintf("%.17g", b$maxiter), sprintf("%.17g", b$iter.max))
})()
cat(paste(value, collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Control parameters for survreg. A supplied iter.max replaces maxiter.
translation.usage: survreg_control(maxiter=30, rel_tolerance=1e-9, toler_chol=1e-10, iter_max=None, debug=0, outer_max=10)
translation.details: Control parameters for survreg. A supplied iter.max replaces maxiter.
translation.example:
from survival import survreg_control

def one():
    a = survreg_control()
    b = survreg_control(iter_max=12)
    return [
        f"{a['maxiter']:.17g}",
        f"{a['rel.tolerance']:.17g}",
        f"{a['toler.chol']:.17g}",
        f"{a['iter.max']:.17g}",
        f"{a['debug']:.17g}",
        f"{a['outer.max']:.17g}",
        f"{b['maxiter']:.17g}",
        f"{b['iter.max']:.17g}",
    ]

print("\n".join(one()))
